iecc.amendments: 2021 IRC Chapter 11 as amended by Utah; 2024 IECC applies to commercial only from 2026-07-01. DOE rates the Utah amendments about equal to the 2009 IECC, so energy.* values differ but were not captured.

nec.amendments: 2021 IRC Chapters 34-43 (2020 NEC basis) for IRC dwellings; 2023 NEC for other installations

plumbing.name: 2024 IPC with Utah amendments (2021 IRC P chapters may apply to IRC dwellings)

elsewhere: Utah State Construction Code applies statewide; cities may not amend beyond state-allowed local amendments.
notes: Checked 2026-10-17. Since 2026-07-01: 2021 IRC kept; 2024 IBC/IPC/IMC/IFGC/IECC (commercial); NEC 2023 for non-IRC work. Utah IRC amendment R303.4 exc.: dwellings tested at 3.0 ACH50 or more need no mechanical ventilation (not tracked). Utah residential energy amendments are significant but values not captured.
